la:noun:zona.html:
zōna (sōna, Ritschl), ae, f., = ζώνη,
a belt, girdle, zone, worn about the loins by women (cf. cingulum).
Lit., ; ; ; ; ; ; —
Transf.
A girdle worn by men for containing money, a money-belt (cf. crumena), C. Gracch. ap. ; .—
The girdle or belt of Orion, a constellation, .—
A line running around the edge of a gem, a girdle, .—
One of the imaginary circles which divided the earth into five climates, a zone, ; ; ; ; ; ; ; .—
A kind of herpes or erysipelas, which spreads about the body like a girdle, and destroys life, the shingles; called also zoster, .

Zōpўrus, i, m., = Ζώπυρος.

A rhetorician, .—Hence, perh.,
Zōpўrion, Lucil. ap. .—
Zōpўriātim, adv., in the manner of Zopyrus, Lucil. ap. .
